notALimit: This finite receiving batch is not a permanent content ceiling or scripted event deck. Expand through the same meaningful operations.

recipes.trigger: Compatible people actually participate in the same work or project
recipes.requiredResult: A remembered introduction or conversation and any freely chosen next contact.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Same employer/proximity automatically means friends.

recipes.trigger: A real old connection gains a present reason or opportunity to reconnect
recipes.requiredResult: A specific response, alternative or nonresponse with preserved identity and context.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Teacher/colleague must contact every player on a fixed date.

recipes.trigger: Someone knows two people and sees a relevant mutual opportunity
recipes.requiredResult: Recipients actually learn permitted contact/context; acceptance is separate.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Friendship transfers automatically along a network edge.

recipes.trigger: Actual cooperative work achieves a supported result
recipes.requiredResult: Participants appraise who contributed and whether to cooperate again.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: A success popup gives all bystanders trust.

recipes.trigger: Two genuine commitments compete for finite time/resources
recipes.requiredResult: A choice, explanation or renegotiation changes the specific commitments.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Create conflict by silently booking mutually impossible routine obligations.

recipes.trigger: A person chooses whether to disclose or protect a specific known matter
recipes.requiredResult: Actual disclosure/access and observer-specific appraisal.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Everyone automatically learns a secret or every disclosure is malicious.

recipes.trigger: A recorded disagreement or breach leaves unresolved tension
recipes.requiredResult: Possible repair/revised terms/separation with trust and warmth allowed to differ.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Apology resets every relationship dimension or conflict namespace always means harm.

recipes.trigger: An actual move/job/office change alters proximity or availability
recipes.requiredResult: The person and history persist; feasible meetings and routes change.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Moving deletes friendships or forces emotional decay.

recipes.trigger: An employer has real available work and a contact knows it
recipes.requiredResult: A reachable recruitment opportunity with appropriate terms; referral is not automatic hiring.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Invent vacancy merely to reward friendship.

recipes.trigger: Candidate has multiple genuine offers or staying is viable
recipes.requiredResult: Explicit chosen terms, declines/lapses and feasible transition.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: All offers stay forever or choosing one automatically fills every other vacancy.

recipes.trigger: Organization has responsibility/capacity need and a candidate is considered
recipes.requiredResult: Role/terms change with evidence; other applicants respond if they learn.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: N shifts automatically promotes or internal promotion counts as a new resident.

recipes.trigger: A chosen career opportunity needs a supported skill/credential
recipes.requiredResult: Background meaningful training progress and later eligibility under actual terms.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Restore rejected certificates, literal homework grind or instant knowledge.

recipes.trigger: Either worker or employer has a real reason to revisit terms
recipes.requiredResult: Agreed/rejected/countered terms have downstream budget and availability consequences.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Charisma creates money or fewer days necessarily means fewer paid hours.

recipes.trigger: An employer decision or contract condition actually ends work
recipes.requiredResult: Correct cessation, remaining obligations and possible job search/support opportunities.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Every missed shift fires someone or hardship forces a political conversion.

recipes.trigger: Worker leaves through a real decision/retirement/move
recipes.requiredResult: Organization adjusts its staffing/delivery; replacement is an independently assessed person.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Vacancy always fills immediately with a newly born adult.

recipes.trigger: Represented employer opens/expands/contracts or transfers ownership
recipes.requiredResult: Capacity and payroll change through real resources and actors.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Every new business grants a fixed universal growth bonus.

recipes.trigger: A proposal changes a specified taxable activity or rate
recipes.requiredResult: Effective rule changes actual collections; behavioral response is separately labelled.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Tax increase automatically triggers positive national revenue-windfall growth.

recipes.trigger: Government considers funding for an actual service
recipes.requiredResult: Authority then actual obligation/payment/staffing yields capacity and delivery.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Passage alone delivers the service or spends every authorized dollar.

recipes.trigger: A proposal changes who may receive a defined supported benefit
recipes.requiredResult: Affected people can qualify/apply/receive under implemented terms.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: A vocabulary label is a completed entitlement model.

recipes.trigger: A health service or coverage rule has a represented need or reform proposal
recipes.requiredResult: Compact coverage/cost/capacity/access states change before any uncertain health-outcome response.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Build a detailed medical simulator first or equate insurance enrollment to treatment.

recipes.trigger: A land-use or building proposal concerns actual sites/households
recipes.requiredResult: Permissions change feasible projects; resources and construction determine eventual supply.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: A zoning vote immediately creates homes.

recipes.trigger: A service asset needs planned maintenance or a proposed resilience upgrade
recipes.requiredResult: Actual completed work changes condition/vulnerability and service continuity.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: A preventive appropriation automatically prevents every future hazard.

recipes.trigger: An operative rule creates a specific reporting, inspection or enforcement duty
recipes.requiredResult: Assigned duties can be fulfilled/overdue/examined and produce supported remedies.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Duty exists only as bill text or allegation equals guilt.

recipes.trigger: A real operative provision is amended, expires or is repealed
recipes.requiredResult: Future application changes coherently, preserving completed acts and surviving obligations.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Repeal erases money already paid or roads already built.

recipes.trigger: A geographically supported hazard episode affects exposed assets
recipes.requiredResult: Actual damage/service loss/displacement then response and recovery.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: One independent flood per household or damage proportional to number of visible characters.

recipes.trigger: Supported wind episode or equipment damage affects connected infrastructure
recipes.requiredResult: Service dependency changes with mitigation and restoration; cascading harm is conditional.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Every severe storm causes the same chain or duplicate damage per article.

recipes.trigger: A supported heat episode meets exposed people and capacity constraints
recipes.requiredResult: Exposure/availability and supported relief measures change; label uncalibrated outcome responses.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Borrow flood-destruction formula for heat or turn temperature into a fixed death quota.

recipes.trigger: Supported cold/snow/ice episode obstructs actual transport/services
recipes.requiredResult: Cancellations/delays/repair are attributed to shared conditions with valid rescheduling.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Advance a traveller past a meeting and leave the meeting pending forever.

recipes.trigger: Supported fire/smoke footprint reaches relevant terrain and assets
recipes.requiredResult: Distinct direct damage, smoke exposure and access effects through their appropriate models.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Treat all state residents as equally exposed or reuse a storm label with no fire mechanism.

recipes.trigger: Persistent supported water deficit pressures actual users
recipes.requiredResult: Resource balance changes service/production with rule-bound responses.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: One dry month universally destroys crops or directly adds the same GDP shock everywhere.

recipes.trigger: A represented water/power/communications/transport component actually fails
recipes.requiredResult: Loss/stabilization/restoration followed by identified causes and possible reform.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: A generic crisis card bypasses the condition of the actual service.

recipes.trigger: A supported health episode or demand rise exceeds represented service capacity
recipes.requiredResult: Care availability and costs respond before separately modelled outcomes.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Invent named disease clinical rates or automatically force civil restrictions.

recipes.trigger: Real revenue/expenditure commitments create projected or actual fiscal pressure
recipes.requiredResult: Feasible adjustment, borrowing or delivery consequences under the government’s powers.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: A deficit headline causes arbitrary default while cash/obligations are ignored.

recipes.trigger: Actual actors disagree over authority, obligations or a consequential decision
recipes.requiredResult: Supported negotiation/review/decision changes authority or action; work elsewhere continues.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Disagreement automatically means violent unrest or whole-game deadlock.

recipes.trigger: A supported cross-border dispute or incident has actors, interests and information
recipes.requiredResult: Plausible proposals, de-escalation, escalation or unresolved continuation with actual effects.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Guaranteed war by year N or same fishing-rights sentence in every save.

recipes.trigger: A real service/project/employer/relationship improvement opens possibilities
recipes.requiredResult: People can pursue new feasible choices in good conditions too.
recipes.forbiddenShortcut: Only crisis or deprivation can generate content.
